args.reason: The old decision forbids writing secrets to .faff/ at all; gitignoring only stops the repo leak and does nothing for the on-disk plaintext key the old decision exists to prevent (logs, backups, shared machines, artifact uploads). The why does not show the old rationale has stopped holding, and the gain is a small per-call latency saving against an env read that costs almost nothing. The supersession argument is unsound.
